# Marian Zeis

> Marian Zeis is an independent SAP developer and consultant in Mainleus, Germany. He builds ARC-1, an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for ABAP development, and speaks on SAP development and UI5.

## Portfolio and sources

- [Profile, projects and podcasts](https://zeis.de/index.html.md): Project descriptions, recent blog posts, podcast appearances and public profiles. Each entry links to its original source.
- [Talks and professional history](https://zeis.de/history/index.html.md): Conference appearances by year with event dates, co-presenters, PDFs, recordings and demos. Includes SAP TechEd, DSAG, UI5con, SAP Inside Track and Devtoberfest.
- [Portfolio in HTML](https://zeis.de/): Public profile with links to individual projects and podcast appearances.
- [Talk archive in HTML](https://zeis.de/history/): Individual talks have permanent links for citation.

## Technical work

- [ARC-1](https://arc-1-mcp.com/): ABAP development tools for AI assistants using SAP ADT.
- [Marian’s blog](https://blog.zeis.de/): First-hand technical articles and project updates.
- [Blog RSS](https://blog.zeis.de/posts/index.xml): Dated posts and their original URLs.
- [SAP AI tools directory](https://sap-ai-tools.marianzeis.de/): Marian’s catalog of SAP and community tools.

## Optional

- [Complete portfolio in one text file](https://zeis.de/llms-full.txt): Profile, projects, podcast appearances, talks, demos, work history and sources.
